theorems.name: Submission.allard52_gpa_graphProj_bilipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), ∃ L₀ : ℝ, 0 < L₀ ∧ L₀ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ ∀ (A B : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), hsNorm A ≤ L₀ → hsNorm B ≤ L₀ → hsNormSq (A - B) ≤ hsNormSq ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).starProjection - (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (B v))).starProjection) ∧ hsNormSq ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).starProjection - (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (B v))).starProjection) ≤ 3 * hsNormSq (A - B)
